parsed.rationale: The cluster row contains an empty `members` array and `null` values for `differing_slots`, `shared_ancestor`, and `shared_field_count`, providing no field-level or method-level evidence to ground a concrete refactor recommendation. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.8333 between `LabeledSlider` (line 18) and `OverridableSlider` (line 63) in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/DebugUI/DebugControlComponents.swift` is high, the distinct names suggest intentionally different roles (a plain labeled slider vs. one with override semantics), and without member lists it is impossible to identify which members should be extracted or shared. Recommending a structural change without grounded member evidence risks introducing incorrect abstractions.
